chunks: Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Shadhuwayh al-Mu'addab (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Ja'far ibn Jami' al-Himyari narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated to us from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Sayf ibn Umayra, from Mudrik ibn al-Hazhaz. He said: al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them both) said:
O Mudrik! May Allah have mercy on a servant who draws the love of the people toward us, narrating to them what they would recognize, and leaving what they would deny.

key_terms.اجتر مودة الناس إلينا: Who draws the love of the people toward us — referring to attracting people's affection toward the Ahl al-Bayt through wise conduct and teaching
key_terms.بما يعرفون: What they recognize — teachings consistent with their prior knowledge and capacity for understanding
key_terms.ما ينكرون: What they deny — advanced or esoteric teachings that listeners are not yet ready to accept

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq teach about how to spread the teachings of the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) addresses his companion Mudrik ibn al-Hazhaz directly, invoking God's mercy upon anyone who draws people's love toward the Ahl al-Bayt. The Imam prescribes a methodology for effective da'wa (outreach): share teachings that resonate with people's existing understanding, and withhold what they would find unfamiliar or reject. This reflects a principle of gradual instruction (tadrij) central to Shi'a educational philosophy, where knowledge is disclosed progressively according to the capacity of the listener.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ali b. al-Husayn b. Shadhuwayh al-Mu'addab (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Abdullah b. Ja`far b. Jami` al-Himyari narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Muhammad narrated to us from his father from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from Sayf b. `Umayra from Mudrik b. al-Hazhar. He said: al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said: O Mudrik!
May Allah have mercy on a servant who causes the people to love us, narrating what they would recognize, and leaving what they would deny.
